name: biso24
description: Ask Claude about your own Biso24 timekeeping, work shifts and requests; can delete your own draft requests.

email.title: Biso24 email
email.description: Email you log in to Biso24 with.

password.title: Biso24 password
password.description: Password you log in to Biso24 with; kept in your OS credential store.

org_id.title: Organization id
org_id.description: Your Organization's id (the orgId sent by the Biso24 web app's login request).

domain.title: Tenant domain
domain.description: Your company's Biso24 host, e.g. acme.biso24.net.
